system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In June 2025, did the Thai Labour Protection Act as then in force give employees the right to leave to assist a spouse who had given birth? Answer briefly.
raw_response:
No. In June 2025 the Thai Labour Protection Act did not provide a specific right to leave to assist a spouse who had given birth.

The relevant provision was **section 41**, which gave a **pregnant employee** maternity leave of up to **98 days per pregnancy**. Other employees only had general **necessary-business leave** under **section 34** (at least 3 working days per year), not a dedicated paternity/spousal childbirth-assistance leave.
